page.notes: The left margin note "Fœdusali-ud." is a catchword-style side note split across two lines, transcribed as one note. The final line "rum" is set flush right and completes "alia-rum". Some words are uncertain: "Largæus" reads as "Iargaus" in the scan, and "Sciringiis" and "Onsleniæ" could be misread. Roman and italic type alternate: the opening through "Principes:" is roman, the rest italic, as far as the scan shows.
